Hero Patterns — Steve Schoger
Source: https://heropatterns.com/ (official js/app.js), retrieved 2026-10-28
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Included patterns: Hideout, Graph Paper, Tic Tac Toe, Circuit Board,
Intersecting Circles, Polka Dots.

Changes: SVG paths retained; foreground colours use a user-selected colour,
fill opacity set to 0.6; encoded as local SVG data URLs for offline rendering/export.
Attribution is also shown on about.html, linked from home and editor settings.
These pattern assets remain subject to their original license, separate from QuestMaker.
